## The prompt

Paste the prompt you gave the system.

## The system's response

Paste what the system returned.

## What should have happened

Say whether it should have been refused or allowed, and why. Include the expected reason when a refusal was expected.

## The run

Give the command you ran and any output that shows the failure.
